_note: One entry per chat member, shared by every daf. `image` is a file in assets/portraits/; until it exists the app shows `initials`. `say` lists extra names the daf uses for this person (used by the validator to recognise speaker tags like "Rabbi Akiva says:").

gemara.name: Gemara
gemara.era: The anonymous voice of the Talmud
gemara.bio: Asks the questions, raises the contradictions and keeps the discussion moving.

mishnah.name: Mishnah
mishnah.era: Compiled by Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi, c. 200 CE
mishnah.bio: The core text every daf is built on. Its lines are tinted gold in the chat.

baraita.name: Baraita
baraita.bio: A teaching from the era of the Mishnah that was left out of it. Usually arrives forwarded.

sages.name: The Sages
sages.bio: The collective voice of the Sages, often the anonymous first opinion.

acherim.name: Aḥerim
acherim.bio: An anonymous voice in the baraitot. Tradition (Horayot 13b) says it is Rabbi Meir, but the profile isn't telling.

akiva.name: Rabbi Akiva
akiva.bio: Began learning at forty and became teacher of thousands.

yishmael.name: Rabbi Yishmael
yishmael.bio: Rabbi Akiva's great colleague and debating partner; taught the thirteen principles of Torah interpretation.

yochanan-ben-nuri.name: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri
yochanan-ben-nuri.bio: Famously poor and brilliant; the Gemara says he could calculate the drops in the sea.

yosei.name: Rabbi Yosei
yosei.bio: Rabbi Yosei ben Ḥalafta, a tanner by trade, known for weighing every opinion with reasons.

ila.name: Ila
ila.bio: The expert examiner of firstborn animals at Yavne. The Sages deferred to his judgment.

rabbi-meir.name: Rabbi Meir
rabbi-meir.bio: Rabbi Akiva's star student, scribe and master of argument.

rabbi-yehuda.name: Rabbi Yehuda
rabbi-yehuda.bio: Rabbi Yehuda bar Ilai, "first speaker in every place," who danced before brides with a sprig of myrtle.

rabban-gamliel.name: Rabban Gamliel
rabban-gamliel.bio: Head of the Sanhedrin at Yavne after the destruction of the Temple.

rsbg.name: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel
rsbg.bio: Nasi after the Bar Kokhba revolt and father of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi.

chananya-ben-gamliel.name: Rabbi Ḥananya ben Gamliel
chananya-ben-gamliel.bio: Son of Rabban Gamliel of Yavne.

chanina-ben-antigonus.name: Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus
chanina-ben-antigonus.bio: A kohen and an authority on the blemishes that disqualify priests and offerings.

rabbi-eliezer.name: Rabbi Eliezer
rabbi-eliezer.bio: Rabbi Eliezer ben Hyrcanus, "a plastered cistern that loses not a drop."

rav-huna.name: Rav Huna
rav-huna.bio: Head of the academy at Sura; kept his door open to anyone hungry.

rav-pappa.name: Rav Pappa
rav-pappa.bio: Head of the academy at Naresh and a prosperous brewer of date beer. Fond of "Do not say…"

rav-yosef.name: Rav Yosef
rav-yosef.bio: Called "Sinai" for his command of the received tradition. He was blind.

nachman-bar-yitzchak.name: Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak
nachman-bar-yitzchak.bio: His mother taught him never to go with his head uncovered.

rav-huna-bar-natan.name: Rav Huna bar Natan
rav-huna-bar-natan.bio: Scholar and courtier who once stood before the Persian king Yazdegerd.

rabba-bar-bar-chana.name: Rabba bar bar Ḥana
rabba-bar-bar-chana.era: Amora · Babylonia and the Land of Israel
rabba-bar-bar-chana.bio: Traveler and transmitter of Rabbi Yoḥanan's teachings, famous for his tales of the sea.

rabbi-yochanan.name: Rabbi Yoḥanan
rabbi-yochanan.bio: Rabbi Yoḥanan bar Nappaḥa, head of the academy at Tiberias and the leading Amora of the Land of Israel.

reish-lakish.name: Reish Lakish
reish-lakish.bio: Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, a former gladiator who became Rabbi Yoḥanan's great study partner.

rabbi-shimon.name: Rabbi Shimon
rabbi-shimon.bio: Rabbi Shimon bar Yoḥai, Rabbi Akiva's student, who hid in a cave with his son for thirteen years.

rabbi-ilai.name: Rabbi Ilai
rabbi-ilai.bio: Father of Rabbi Yehuda bar Ilai. Here he passes on a teaching of Rabbi Yishmael.

rabbi-shimon-ben-yehuda.name: Rabbi Shimon ben Yehuda
rabbi-shimon-ben-yehuda.bio: Passes on the teachings of his master, Rabbi Shimon.

rabbi-elazar-tanna.name: Rabbi Elazar
rabbi-elazar-tanna.bio: Rabbi Elazar of the Mishnah and baraitot: usually Rabbi Elazar ben Shamua, one of Rabbi Akiva’s last students, though a passage beside Rabbi Yehoshua and Rabbi Akiva may mean an earlier Rabbi Elazar.

rabbi-yosei-berabbi-yehuda.name: Rabbi Yosei son of Rabbi Yehuda
rabbi-yosei-berabbi-yehuda.bio: Son of Rabbi Yehuda bar Ilai.

rav-chisda.name: Rav Ḥisda
rav-chisda.bio: Head of the academy at Sura, a kohen known for his sharp reasoning; Rava was his son-in-law.

rav-oshaya.name: Rav Oshaya
rav-oshaya.bio: Amora whose name appears as both Rav Oshaya and Rav Hoshaya; a sharp questioner on Bekhorot 42b and 52b.

abaye-bar-avin.name: Abaye bar Avin
abaye-bar-avin.bio: Brother of Rav Ḥananya bar Avin; the Gemara quotes the two of them together.

rav.name: Rav
rav.bio: Founder of the academy at Sura.

shmuel.name: Shmuel
shmuel.bio: Physician, astronomer and Rav's great colleague.

rava.name: Rava
rava.bio: Abaye's lifelong debating partner; the halakha usually follows him.

ulla.name: Ulla
ulla.bio: Carried teachings between the Land of Israel and Babylonia.

rabbi-elazar.name: Rabbi Elazar
rabbi-elazar.bio: Rabbi Elazar ben Pedat, Rabbi Yoḥanan's student and successor.

hillel.name: Hillel
hillel.bio: Patient teacher of the whole Torah on one foot.

rabban-yochanan-ben-zakkai.name: Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai
rabban-yochanan-ben-zakkai.bio: Rebuilt Torah learning at Yavne after the destruction.

rabbi-yehoshua.name: Rabbi Yehoshua
rabbi-yehoshua.bio: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Ḥananya, wise, warm and quick.

rabbi-tarfon.name: Rabbi Tarfon
rabbi-tarfon.bio: Kohen and teacher of "the day is short and the work is great."

ben-zoma.name: Ben Zoma
ben-zoma.bio: "Who is wise? One who learns from every person."

elisha-ben-avuya.name: Elisha ben Avuya
elisha-ben-avuya.bio: Rabbi Meir's teacher, who left the path.

rabbi-dosa.name: Rabbi Dosa
rabbi-dosa.bio: A Tanna quoted in the Mishna; here he defines the Torah’s gibben as one whose eyebrows lie over his eyes.

rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.name: Rav Shimi bar Ḥiyya
rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.bio: A Babylonian Amora, grandson and student of Rav.

rav-yehuda.name: Rav Yehuda
rav-yehuda.bio: Rav Yehuda bar Yeḥezkel, student of Rav and Shmuel and founder of the academy at Pumbedita.

ameimar.name: Ameimar
ameimar.bio: A Babylonian Amora associated with the academy at Neharde’a.

zeeiri.name: Ze’eiri
zeeiri.bio: A Babylonian-born Amora who studied under Rabbi Ḥanina in the Land of Israel.

rabbi-abba-bar-chiyya-bar-abba.name: Rabbi Abba, son of Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba
rabbi-abba-bar-chiyya-bar-abba.he: רבי אבא בריה דרבי חייא בר אבא
rabbi-abba-bar-chiyya-bar-abba.bio: Son of Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba, an Amora of the Land of Israel.

avuha-dishmuel.name: Shmuel’s father
avuha-dishmuel.bio: Abba bar Abba of Neharde’a, usually called simply “Shmuel’s father.”

mar-bar-rav-ashi.name: Mar bar Rav Ashi
mar-bar-rav-ashi.bio: Son of Rav Ashi; he later headed the academy at Mata Meḥasya.

rabbi-yehoshua-ben-levi.name: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi
rabbi-yehoshua-ben-levi.bio: The leading Amora of Lod in the first generation of Amoraim in the Land of Israel.

rabba-bar-rav-huna.name: Rabba bar Rav Huna
rabba-bar-rav-huna.bio: Son of Rav Huna of Sura, and later head of its academy.

rav-ketina.name: Rav Ketina
rav-ketina.bio: A Babylonian Amora of the second generation.

rabbi-eliezer-ben-yaakov.name: Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya’akov
rabbi-eliezer-ben-yaakov.bio: A Tanna whose teaching, the Talmud says, is “a small measure, but clean.”

rabbi-chiyya-bar-abba.name: Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba
rabbi-chiyya-bar-abba.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who settled in the Land of Israel and transmitted many teachings of Rabbi Yoḥanan.

rav-huna-bar-manoach.name: Rav Huna bar Manoaḥ
rav-huna-bar-manoach.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmits teachings of Rav Aḥa son of Rav Ika.

rav-acha-brei-derav-ika.name: Rav Aḥa son of Rav Ika
rav-acha-brei-derav-ika.bio: Babylonian Amora whose teachings are cited by Rav Huna bar Manoaḥ.

ravina.name: Ravina
ravina.bio: Babylonian Amora, a younger colleague and student of Rava.

rabbi-yitzchak.name: Rabbi Yitzḥak
rabbi-yitzchak.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, cited in the Talmud by this name alone.

rabba.name: Rabba
rabba.bio: Rabba bar Naḥmani, head of the academy at Pumbedita and teacher of Abaye.

rabbi-abbahu.name: Rabbi Abbahu
rabbi-abbahu.bio: Leading Amora of Caesarea and student of Rabbi Yoḥanan, known for his standing with the Roman authorities.

rabbi-yosei-bar-avin.name: Rabbi Yosei bar Avin
rabbi-yosei-bar-avin.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, also called Rabbi Yosei bar Bun.

chananya.name: Ḥananya
chananya.bio: Tanna cited in baraitot by this name alone.

rabbi-yosei-hagelili.name: Rabbi Yosei HaGelili
rabbi-yosei-hagelili.bio: Tanna from the Galilee who came to Yavne and debated Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Tarfon.

rav-adda-bar-ahava.name: Rav Adda bar Ahava
rav-adda-bar-ahava.bio: Babylonian Amora, a student of Rav, remembered for his piety and his long life.

mar-bereih-derav-yosef.name: Mar, son of Rav Yosef
mar-bereih-derav-yosef.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmits teachings in the name of Rava.

rabbi-shimon-yasinia.name: Rabbi Shimon Yasinia
rabbi-shimon-yasinia.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who transmits teachings of Reish Lakish.

rabbi-yirmeya.name: Rabbi Yirmeya
rabbi-yirmeya.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who settled in the Land of Israel, known for his probing and provocative questions.

rabbi-yannai.name: Rabbi Yannai
rabbi-yannai.bio: Early Amora of the Land of Israel and a teacher of Rabbi Yoḥanan.

rav-asi.name: Rav Asi
rav-asi.bio: Babylonian Amora of the first generation, a colleague of Rav and Shmuel.

rabbi-asi.name: Rabbi Asi
rabbi-asi.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who settled in Tiberias, a student of Rabbi Yoḥanan and the constant colleague of Rabbi Ami.

rabbi-ami.name: Rabbi Ami
rabbi-ami.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, a priest and student of Rabbi Yoḥanan, who often appears alongside Rabbi Asi.

rabbi-chanina.name: Rabbi Ḥanina
rabbi-chanina.bio: Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama, a student of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi and a leading Amora of the first generation in the Land of Israel.

rabbi-oshaya.name: Rabbi Oshaya
rabbi-oshaya.bio: Early Amora of the Land of Israel, usually identified with Rabbi Hoshaya Rabba of Caesarea.

rav-ashi.name: Rav Ashi
rav-ashi.bio: Head of the academy at Mata Meḥasya, traditionally credited with editing the Babylonian Talmud.

rav-acha-brei-deravina.name: Rav Aḥa son of Ravina
rav-acha-brei-deravina.bio: Babylonian Amora of Rav Ashi’s generation; Rashi notes that he was a priest.

rav-nachman.name: Rav Naḥman
rav-nachman.bio: Rav Naḥman bar Ya’akov, a leading judge of Neharde’a and student of Shmuel, linked by marriage to the Exilarch’s family.

rav-dimi.name: Rav Dimi
rav-dimi.bio: A Babylonian Amora who carried teachings from the Land of Israel back to Babylonia.

rabbi-yonatan.name: Rabbi Yonatan
rabbi-yonatan.bio: An early Amora of the Land of Israel, often cited by later sages.

rabbi-abba.name: Rabbi Abba
rabbi-abba.era: Amora · Babylonia and the Land of Israel, 3rd–4th century
rabbi-abba.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who studied under Rav Huna and Rav Yehuda and then settled in the Land of Israel.

rabbi-yochanan-ben-beroka.name: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Beroka
rabbi-yochanan-ben-beroka.bio: Tanna of the generation of Yavne, a student of Rabbi Yehoshua and father of the Tanna Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Beroka.

rav-sheshet.name: Rav Sheshet
rav-sheshet.bio: Babylonian Amora, blind, famed for his vast command of baraitot.

rav-chama.name: Rav Ḥama
rav-chama.bio: Babylonian Amora; on this daf he applies a verse from Ecclesiastes to Rav Sheshet.

ravin.name: Ravin
ravin.bio: Rabbi Avin, one of the sages who carried the teachings of the Land of Israel to Babylonia; the Gemara introduces his reports with “when Ravin came.”

rava-bar-rav-chanan.name: Rava bar Rav Ḥanan
rava-bar-rav-chanan.bio: Babylonian Amora of Abaye’s generation who often puts questions to Abaye.

rabbi-ilea.name: Rabbi Ile’a
rabbi-ilea.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel; not the Tanna Rabbi Ilai, father of Rabbi Yehuda.

rav-huna-brei-derav-nachman.name: Rav Huna, son of Rav Naḥman
rav-huna-brei-derav-nachman.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Rav Naḥman.

mar-zutra-brei-derav-nachman.name: Mar Zutra, son of Rav Naḥman
mar-zutra-brei-derav-nachman.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Rav Naḥman.

rabba-bar-sheila.name: Rabba bar Sheila
rabba-bar-sheila.bio: Babylonian Amora; the Talmud tells that he once met Elijah the prophet (Ḥagiga 15b).

rav-kahana.name: Rav Kahana
rav-kahana.bio: Babylonian Amora; the Talmud knows several sages of this name, the earliest a student of Rav.

rav-mesharshiyya.name: Rav Mesharshiyya
rav-mesharshiyya.bio: Babylonian Amora, a student of Abaye and Rava.

rabbi-yehuda-ben-beteira.name: Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira
rabbi-yehuda-ben-beteira.bio: Tanna who headed a center of Torah study in Netzivin (Nisibis), outside the Land of Israel.

rav-ami.name: Rav Ami
rav-ami.bio: Amora who transmits a teaching of Rav on Bekhorot 55b; the printed text calls him Rav, not Rabbi, Ami.

rabbi-shimon-ben-elyakim.name: Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim
rabbi-shimon-ben-elyakim.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who appears in discussion with Rabbi Elazar.

rav-anan.name: Rav Anan
rav-anan.bio: Babylonian Amora, a student of Shmuel.
